title: List every VCF Installer task while refreshing an expired access token
prompt: Implement `VcfInstallerClient.java` as a Java 17, standard-library-only client for the pinned VMware Cloud Foundation Installer 9.0 contract in `docs/contract.json`. Keep the production implementation in that single Java source file and preserve the public API used by `TestMain.java`. `listAllTaskIds` must call the exact `createToken`, `getTasks`, and `refreshAccessToken` operations: create a token pair with only `username` and `password`, retrieve every task page in order using only `pageNumber` and `pageSize`, and send the access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. When a page request returns 401, refresh the access token by PATCHing the refresh-token ID as a JSON string, then retry that same page without discarding already collected task IDs, replaying completed pages, or creating a new token pair. Use `Accept: application/json`, use `Content-Type: application/json` only for JSON request bodies, JSON-escape credentials correctly, and fail on unexpected HTTP statuses or malformed required response data. Optional token fields (`apiKey`, `idToken`) and all unused optional `getTasks` query parameters must be omitted, not sent with empty or default values. Run `python3 -B verify.py` to exercise the client against the loopback fixture; verification never contacts a live VMware endpoint. Edit only `VcfInstallerClient.java`.
scenario: the access token expires after a completed task page and the client must refresh once before retrying the interrupted page
constraint: the loopback request log verifies pagination continuity and complete omission of unused optional request fields
